body.name: Parameterized late-ramp family
body.construction: Fix \(c\in(0,1)\), \(a_\star\in(0,1)\), \(0<\delta\le M\), \(\rho\ge c\), \(K\ge c\), and \(L_r\ge\delta/(1-a_\star)\). For \(\sigma\in\{-1,1\}\), set \(\bar q^\sigma(u)=c\), \(r^\sigma(u)=\sigma\delta(u-a_\star)_+/(1-a_\star)\), \(e_{nt}=c/t\), \(m_{nt}(0)=m_{nt}(1)=0\), \(Y_{nt}^\sigma(0)=0\), and \(Y_{nt}^\sigma(1)=r^\sigma(t/n)\). The sequential design uses \(\Pr_\sigma(A_{nt}=1\mid\mathcal F_{n,t-1})=e_{nt}\), and \(O_n=(A_{n1:n},e_{n1:n},Y_{n1:n}^{\mathrm{obs}},m_{n1:n})\).
